name: Distance and water tank level
summary: An HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor measures distance; mounted above a tank it gives the water level in %. Reports a sensor problem instead of a wrong number.
parts: HC-SR04 (or waterproof JSN-SR04T for closed tanks)
use: Ultrasonic sonar(9, 10); TankLevel tank(sonar, 120, 15); setup: sonar.begin(); loop: tank.percent()

points.note: Sound travels 0.0343 cm per microsecond; halve it because the sound goes down and back.
The middle of the sorted readings (the median) ignores one odd echo better than an average would.
